title: Point the AGENTS.md managed block at the one rules file
description: Agent judgment now lives in docs/public/agents/rules.md, with Claude-only steps in docs/public/agents/claude.md, and the twelve per-operation rule files no longer ship. The AGENTS.md managed block now points to .yoke/docs/agents/rules.md, but under a heading still titled Operation homes beside the Live recipes line. Desired: the managed block names the rules file directly with no operation-home framing. Until that managed block change ships in a refreshed install, the project-native surface stays current-state only.
